correctness.rationale: The exact CDF yields the survival expansion by one Taylor expansion at the upper BSH endpoint. The published density independently gives the matching density constant, and division yields the hazard equivalent. The MGF trichotomy follows from the sign of \(tx-x^\alpha\), with the boundary case \(\alpha=1\) handled explicitly. Polynomial moments are finite by Weibull-type integrability, and the quantile equivalent follows by logarithmic inversion. A standalone high-precision checker replayed from the package path confirms all three normalized asymptotic ratios.

value.rationale: Tail behavior and hazard flexibility are central stated motivations of the EBSH model, and the paper explicitly interprets its tail class. The finding supplies a complete natural phase classification over the full alpha parameter range, corrects a family-wide light-tail assertion, identifies theta's precise asymptotic role, and determines the positive-MGF domain, long-tail property, terminal hazard, and extreme-quantile scale. These are structural reliability and extreme-value properties rather than a finite numerical discrepancy.
